request.query: floor x is greater than x minus one; comparison between square of x and square of floor x

items.name: Int.sub_one_lt_floor
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorRing R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (a : R),
  a - 1 < ↑⌊a⌋

items.name: Nat.sub_one_lt_floor
items.type:

items.name: Int.floor_le

items.name: Int.floor_le_iff
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorRing R] {z : ℤ} {a : R}, ⌊a⌋ ≤ z ↔ a < ↑z + 1
